title: The Weir and the Eel Traps — one league upriver of Sill
caption: The eel weir on the Ilm a league upriver of Sill, drawn at the ground the trap-keepers walk: the V of stakes and its traps, the plank walk, Orra Weir's hut and salting-racks, the hearth-maids' blessing stone, the shoals and reeds, and the river road. Surveyed and inked in Y.H. 812, the Thin Year.
